description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ulpathagama (Block 01), Palagala D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110748 (24/120059)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act.
